name: BigToM
description: BigToM is a social reasoning benchmark for large language models that evaluates Theory-of-Mind capabilities using 5,000 model-written evaluations generated via a novel procedural framework. It includes 25 control conditions and is rated highly by humans, enabling comparison of LLM social reasoning performance with human inference patterns.
reputation: A newer social reasoning benchmark that is notable for its large procedurally generated set of Theory-of-Mind evaluations and human validation.
notes: Uses LLMs to generate evaluations; assesses Theory-of-Mind reasoning in LLMs compared to humans.
